Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Abstract Area Rug, 5' 11" x 3' 11", Ivory, Black
Colors: Ivory/Black Abstract
An abstract pattern against an ivory background will bring a modern global flair to your home. Offered in a variety of colors that will blend with most any room, the soft design is accented by light fringe. 5' 11" x 3' 11" Medium-high pile is soft and easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
